purpose: Use actual retained baseline evidence to investigate and correct the scoped Go defect through the complete delivery process.

execution.instructions: The retained scaffold is already restored. Use supplied baseline and later measurement feedback to establish the cause and correct only the authorized scope. Failed or absent samples are failure evidence, not passing timing claims. Further configured measurement is a handoff, not a missing capability; return ready with a runnable candidate when it is needed. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Read the relevant source and contracts once; follow imports only for concrete questions. Preserve public behavior, puzzle identities, difficulty meanings, saved games and unrelated work. Generated files, manifests and dependencies are protected. Use the smallest idiomatic change and meaningful existing coverage; new tests need a concrete regression purpose. Do not run checks, Git, agents or external work: configured downstream steps own checks, measurements, review, publication and qualification. On a correction visit use the retained source and supplied check/review/measurement/qualification feedback; keep acceptance conditions fixed and correct only the original scope. A missing capability, infrastructure problem or material decision returns blocked. Never change the workflow, permissions, budgets or acceptance conditions. Return a concise summary of changed paths, behavior and remaining proof, at most 240 characters. Do not claim pending checks passed.
